digest.component_or_area: Cloud comment outbound reconciliation — dedup key fitting
propositions: The Cloud comment differ's body-equality dedup key is fitted with plain-character truncation at 32,767 characters, while the send path fits the serialized ADF representation against a 32,000-byte limit, causing them to diverge for over-length comments.

For an over-length comment (e.g. 40,000+ chars), the comparison key returns 32,767 chars but the actual landed body in Jira is shorter (e.g. 31,753 chars), so body-equality never matches even if the comment is already in Jira.

The divergence was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt), which moved the send path from the shared truncate_comment_body helper to AdfCodec.fit_outbound while leaving the differ's fit_comment on the old plain-cap helper.

The differ key must be byte-identical to the text the send path actually lands; the fix makes _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment return fit_comment_as_sent composed with the Cloud AdfCodec, restoring convergence without affecting Data Center or shared modules.
The dedup key is computed in-memory per pass and never persisted, so no migration risk exists; the fix can only add skips, never remove them, so already-landed comments cannot be re-posted.
